note: Scaled/anchored via body landmarks (head-top to feet-bottom span, torso centerline), not raw bbox height, since the wingtip inflates the raw bbox well beyond the body extent. Body height on canvas (~756px) reads a bit smaller than the shared 873px convention used by other attack frames because fitting the FULL wingspan without any clipping required a smaller base scale; SOUTH_ATTACK_SCALE in game.js applies an additional bottom-anchored render-time multiplier (~1.155x) to bring the displayed body size back in line with the other directions, exactly like the existing SOUTH_WALK_SCALE/PRE_ATTACK_SCALE/NORTH_IDLE_SCALE pattern.
